summary.a: A 1940 East End bungalow with three bedrooms, two full baths and 1,385 square feet, rebuilt from the foundation up.

photos.a: with a clerestory window and a wide opening to the Dining area and Kitchen.
under a vaulted ceiling with an exposed painted beam.
A covered patio, 8'11" x 25'11", and a covered garage, 14'4" x 24'3", in the fenced yard.

frontRooms.title: How do the front rooms connect?
frontRooms.intro: The front door opens into the Living Room, and wood-look floors run from there to the Kitchen with no thresholds.

photos.q: What does the cased opening join?
photos.a: A wide cased opening joins it to the Dining area and Kitchen, so the whole front of the home works as one room.
between the Kitchen peninsula and the hall to the bedrooms. Two pendants hang over the breakfast bar.

photos.q: How is the Kitchen laid out?
photos.a: All new, in an L with a peninsula, and open to the Dining area and Living Room. The pantry and Breakfast Nook are just around the corner.
beside the Kitchen, with windows on two walls and a door out to the backyard deck.

plan.note: Street side at left, covered patio and garage at right. Approximate; not to scale. Buyer to verify.

bedsBaths.title: Where are the bedrooms and baths?
bedsBaths.intro: Three bedrooms and two full baths. Bedrooms 2 and 3 share the hall bath, so the Primary bath stays private.

pair.q: How is the Primary set up?
pair.a: A vaulted ceiling with an exposed painted beam, windows on two walls, a double-door closet and a doorway to the Primary bath on the closet wall.

pair.q: Is the Primary away from the street?
pair.a: Yes. It is at the back of the home, across the house from Bedroom 2.

tiles.a: A dark navy vanity with a stone top under an LED backlit mirror.
Marble-look tile floor to ceiling, a glass door, a rain showerhead and a handheld.

outside.title: What is new, and what is nearby?

exterior.a: Hardi Plank siding, a new roof and a new driveway. The front door opens from the porch into the Living Room.

backyard.a: Out back, the fenced yard has the covered patio, 8'11" x 25'11", with the covered garage, 14'4" x 24'3", beside it.
